details:
To the VRChat and VCC Development Team,

After the latest VCC update, all Unity projects I had stored inside the Templates folder were deleted without any warning. This resulted in the complete loss of my working files.

Because VCC allows users to open and edit Unity projects directly inside “VRCTemplate” folders, it is natural for users to assume this is a valid and safe location to work in.

However, I discovered—only after losing my data—that the Templates folder is treated as a cache and may be wiped during updates.

This behavior is extremely problematic because:

The Templates folder is visible and accessible to the user

It contains a fully functional Unity project that can be opened and edited

Users are never warned that it is unsafe to work inside

Updates remove the folder without notice, causing data loss

Given the severity of this issue, I strongly request that you:

Add a clear warning before updates

Prevent editing inside template folders

Or provide a safer and more explicit workflow

This issue is a critical UX flaw that can (and has) caused irreversible data loss for users.

Thank you for your attention.
title: Subject: VCC Update Deleted All Projects Inside Templates Folder Without Any Warning
